CREATE VIEW "BY_DAY"."DIM_DATE_DAY_ID" AS SELECT "DAY_ID", "MONTH_ID", "YEAR_ID", "DAY_NAME" FROM "master"."DIM_DATE_DAY_ID"

CREATE VIEW "BY_DAY"."BY_DAY" AS WITH "base_fact_orders" AS (
  SELECT
    "fact_orders"."DAY_ID" AS "DAY_ID",
    "fact_orders"."ORDERS" AS "ORDERS"
  FROM "master"."FACT_ORDERS" AS "fact_orders"
),
"base_fact_revenue" AS (
  SELECT
    "fact_revenue"."DAY_ID" AS "DAY_ID",
    SUM("fact_revenue"."REVENUE") AS "REVENUE"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "fact_revenue"."DAY_ID" AS "DAY_ID",
      "fact_revenue"."SKU_ID" AS "SKU_ID",
      COALESCE("fact_revenue"."REVENUE", 0) AS "REVENUE"
    FROM "master"."FACT_REVENUE" AS "fact_revenue"
  ) AS "fact_revenue"
  GROUP BY "fact_revenue"."DAY_ID"
)
SELECT
  "dim_date"."DAY_ID",
  COALESCE("dim_date"."DAY_NAME", 'UNKNOWN'),
  (SUM("fact_revenue"."REVENUE") / NULLIF(SUM("fact_orders"."ORDERS"), 0)) AS "AOV"
FROM "base_fact_orders" AS "fact_orders"
JOIN "base_fact_revenue" AS "fact_revenue" ON "fact_orders"."DAY_ID" = "fact_revenue"."DAY_ID"
JOIN "BY_DAY"."DIM_DATE_DAY_ID" AS "dim_date" ON "fact_orders"."DAY_ID" = "dim_date"."DAY_ID"
GROUP BY
  "dim_date"."DAY_ID",
  COALESCE("dim_date"."DAY_NAME", 'UNKNOWN')
